description: Construction of a Roof Cover for the Maligavila Buddha Statue
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2010-09-27
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Jagath Balasuriya, Minister of National Heritage, to construct a permanent roof cover for the Maligavila Buddha Statue, located 15 km away from Buttala town, utilizing Rs.15 million provided by the Central Cultural Fund to the Ministry, was approved by the Cabinet.
